seo.title: Every plugin OpenMixer ships | OpenMixer
seo.description: Each omx plugin: what it does, its controls and its panel, drawn from its declaration.

hero.title: Every plugin, its controls and its panel.
hero.lede: One page for each plugin the omx-plugins package ships. The words, the controls and the panel picture all come from the plugin's own declaration: nothing here is drawn or typed by hand.

index.title: The plugins.
index.intro: Pick a plugin to see what it does, every control it has and the panel a host draws for it.

page.panelNote: This is the panel a host draws from the plugin's declaration, every control at its default. It was laid out by omx-panel and drawn by its renderer, with no host running and no screenshot.
page.panelAlt: The panel of {name}, drawn from its declaration
page.controlsNote: Section by section, in the order the panel shows them. The names, units, ranges and defaults are the declaration's.
